simulator_calibration.scope: Standard damage fatigue only; source timing before HP reduction, overkill skip, integer quotient/truncation, pre-AOS armor reduction zero. No other mechanics changed.

deployed_evidence.fatigue_method_verified: ikdasm disassembled deployed Server.Misc.WeightOverloading.FatigueOnDamage, 251 IL bytes. Reviewed against current source. Local Scripts.dll differs as a whole; method body has only a changed internal BaseArmor method metadata token, resolving to GetInherentStaminaLossReduction in deployed IL.

formula.standard: fatigue = damage * (HitsMax integer_divide max(1, Hits)) * (double(Stam) / StamMax) - 5
formula.armor: GetInherentStaminaLossReduction returns 0 when !Core.SA; no reduction in this pre-AOS environment
formula.subtract: if fatigue>0: loss=int(fatigue*(double(Hits)/HitsMax)) if Stam-fatigue<=10 else int(fatigue); Stam=max(0,Stam-loss)
formula.timing: Mobile.Damage computes oldHits-amount and invokes fatigue before assigning newHits only when newHits>=0. Exact-zero damage follows fatigue path; overkill skips it.
formula.simulator_fractional_boundary: Existing fractional HP, regen and spell damage remain. HP/maxHP/damage/stamina inputs are truncated to source integer field types inside fatigue calculation; original simulator amount<=HP determines its branch.

simulator_calibration.training_isolation: Both initial two-arm v4 training jobs had imported simulator before this edit. Do not compare v4 and v5 scores as a fixed environment. Use v5 for the predeclared calibrated continuation and parent/candidate evaluation.

Live cursor/target/ack cadence increases action duration. b470 EnergyBolt option3.148s; v5 immediate simulator target after cast remains approximate.
Refresh potion is supplied by server but absent from the fixed23-action schema; v5 damage stamina can therefore constrain mobility longer than a complete UO action set would.

fourth_match.sha_note: The SHA above is metadata.sha256 for the replay payload, not a hash of the metadata file. Metadata file hash was not computed. Parent may independently verify downloaded payload.
fourth_match.exclusion: Incomplete collection plus three inference deadline rejections; do not reconstruct a trainable episode by relaxing the integrity gate.

journal_cessation.interpretation: Both clients observed lobby teleport around normal match end, then journal state stopped. Final Idle was not received. Server disconnects were logged at collector cleanup. This does not identify whether decoding, transport input, or server response delivery stalled.

linux_rollover_hypothesis.push_proof: 0x36e1b3 checks512-entry bound; 0x36e1ff adds evicted count to World+0x780 journal_offset; 0x36e211 stores saturated offset.
linux_rollover_hypothesis.observe_proof: 0x369c3b reads World+0x780; 0x369c4b adds retained len for absolute end; 0x369c66 subtracts offset from cursor with saturating branch; 0x369c6d..70 clamps slice start to retained len.
linux_rollover_hypothesis.conclusion: Existing Linux binary already implements absolute journal offsets across eviction. A stale binary alone is not evidence of the old512-line rollover fault.

server_state.world_save_note: Approximately44seconds before match end; no evidence linking save to final journal cessation.

previous_collection_diagnosis.recommended_next_diagnostic: An isolated Linux bridge built from existing diagnostics branch, followed by one bounded match-end/lobby reproduction, would expose bytes/packets/buffer/journal counters. No speculative rollover patch or shard restart justified.
